description: Delete a note. By default it is moved to the vault .trash/ folder (recoverable by moving it back); pass permanent: true to remove it outright.

path.description: Vault-relative path of the note to delete.

permanent.description: Permanently remove instead of moving to .trash/. Defaults to false.

prevHash.description: Optional compare-and-swap guard: the contentHash from a prior read. Fails with hash_conflict if the note changed since — so you never delete content you have not seen.

name: delete_note
